labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: gifts in a closed period that are not posted.
labels.value: These gifts are dated on or before the day the books are closed through, so they are already locked from editing, but nothing has marked them posted to accounting. If they genuinely belong in the export you already sent, mark them posted from the Accounting Export page (Connect). Without Connect, or if they should not have been closed yet, move Books Closed Through back to reopen the period (needs the Override Posting Lock permission).

Health Check title: someone holds the Override Receipt Lock permission
labels.value: Someone can override the receipt lock

labels.shortDescription: Health Check detail: who holds the Override Receipt Lock permission
labels.value: The Override Receipt Lock permission lets a person change or delete a gift that already carries a receipt number. Open Impact grants it to nobody: it is meant to be assigned in Setup for one correction and taken away again. It is held by {0}. If nobody is correcting a receipted gift right now, remove it in Setup, Custom Permissions. Every change made with it is in the Error Log.

Title of the single receipt generation failure finding.
labels.value: One receipt number was used by a run that failed

labels.shortDescription: Explains the single reconciled receipt number, which is ordinary.
labels.value: One receipt is recorded as Void with the reason Generation failed. That is the record of a number that was handed out to a document which never generated, and a single one is ordinary rather than a problem. The Error Log says what went wrong, and the receipt can be run again once it is fixed.

labels.shortDescription: Title of the repeated receipt generation failure finding.
Explains that receipt generation has failed repeatedly.
labels.value: {0} receipts are recorded as Void with the reason Generation failed, which means receipt generation has failed that many times and those donors are still waiting for their documents. Read the receipt entries in the Error Log, fix what they name, and run the receipts again. Leave the void records alone: they are what accounts for the numbers that were used.

labels.shortDescription: Fix button on the receipt generation findings: open the Error Log.
